text:
alex: Opening a docs PR for rate limits / quotas / pricing analytics updates — adds tier examples, clarifies metering units, and links the new dashboard widgets. Want quick reviews before I merge tomorrow morning.

maria: Thanks alex. tagging @devlin for the SDK snippets and @kevin for pricing numbers. can you also add a short migration note for customers moving from per-minute to per-second quotas? :thinking_face: 

devlin: saw the PR. i'll add a Python + curl snippet showing how to read X-RateLimit-* headers from the API response. will push in a sec. example: 
```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
# headers available on resp.meta.headers
print(resp.meta.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit'))
```

alex: perfect. also added a note about how the console shows token-metering vs request-metering. link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/usage?view=rate_limits (placeholder, will be updated)

sam: for the migration guide: we should call out difference between soft quotas (throttling with 429 + Retry-After) and hard quotas (blocking until next billing period). i'll draft a short section.

kevin: heads up — pricing numbers are WIP. i put placeholders for tier pricing (Starter / Pro / Enterprise). Finance will confirm by EOD. please mark them as TBC in the doc so we don't push live numbers.

maria: also fixed two broken links in the analytics section (old grafana -> new console). added redirects. subtle phrasing: changed "requests" to "metering units (tokens)" where it was ambiguous.

devlin: pushed SDK snippet commit. added an example that demonstrates client-side exponential backoff when you hit rate limit: 
```js
// pseudo
async function retryRequest() {
  for (let i=0;i<5;i++){
    try { return await client.generate({prompt}); } catch(e){
      if (e.status==429) await sleep(2**i * 100); else throw e;
    }
  }
}
```

alex: thanks. i also added a small code block showing how to opt into the "detailed usage" header in requests so customers can surface per-route metrics: 
```bash
curl -H "X-RW-Usage-Detail: full" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

kevin: re: dashboard screenshots — we need a note about data latency (metrics update every ~2 min). otherwise support tickets will spike. please add a small callout.

sam: added the migration wording + short FAQ item about overage billing vs throttling. left a TODO for legal to confirm the exact phrasing.

alex: done a pass on language and headings. one remaining styling nit: docs-bot complained about a missing image alt text on the quotas table screenshot. i've added alt text.

docs-bot: lint OK after latest commits — 4 warnings (image alt text, link target, copy length).

deploy-bot: staging docs build succeeded — preview available at https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/1763700000

maria: can we hold on merging until finance confirms numbers? kevin?

kevin: yes — i'll approve content but mark pricing TBC. once finance gives the numbers i'll update the PR and ping for final merge.

alex: SG. i'll merge tomorrow 09:00 PT if no objections and after kevin flips TBC. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sam: ack. i'll sync with support to prep a short blurb in case customers ask about the new quota semantics.

alex: ended up adding a quick note about measuring per-route token usage in the console and linking the new 'per-route' widget docs. that's it from me.

maria: thanks — great cleanup.

kevin: approving the doc content. leaving pricing placeholder.

alex: marking thread resolved. merging tomorrow unless finance raises issues.
